review_basis: Unchanged SOURCE-REVIEW.md. Semantics assessed from prose and source-correct quoted fragments; reconstructed/noncontiguous quotations remain citation failures. Cross-finding dispatch supplies copy/yield mode.

findings.note: Correct adapter, controlled generator hops, final response/history and unsent _next. Missing response-hook ordering, default allow_redirects=True and final non-stream content consumption.
Correct status/method rules including HEAD and 307/308.
Correct status-based purge independent of method changes. Required rebuild_method-before-purge ordering is absent.
Correct stream exclusions, tell position, OSError sentinel and failure purpose.
Correct position/header guards, integer seek, OSError and sentinel/missing seek failures.
Correct hostname, standard upgrade, equivalent default ports and other scheme/port changes.
Correct old/new URL policy and independent trust_env/netrc replacement.

Environment/bypass, fallback and precedence are correct, but None-to-empty mapping behavior is missing. Quoted proxy_keys are a reconstructed expression rather than verbatim code and combined with another function; citation failure is separate.

Correct resolved scheme lookup, old header removal and conditional Basic/HTTPS handling. Quoted KeyError fragment supplies missing-key handling, though omitted intervening comments invalidate the contiguous citation.
Correct previous-request extraction, merge/header preparation and session extraction from sent hop responses for later iterations.

Copy/yield mode are supplied in dispatch. Correct refreshed target, fallback exception types in quoted fragment, limit/close, fragment and URL normalization. Noncontiguous quote is a separate citation failure.
